name: Performance regression loop
objective: Turn a reproducible performance regression into a profiled, narrow fix that restores the budget without weakening correctness.

trigger.cadence_or_event: A benchmark or service-level metric regresses beyond the declared noise tolerance.

intake.selection_rule: Investigate only a regression reproducible under the pinned workload and controlled environment.

workspace.isolation: Clean worktree on fixed benchmark hardware or a controlled runner.

agents.responsibility: Confirm the regression under the frozen workload and environment.
Localize time, allocation, I/O, or contention hotspots before edits.
Apply one evidence-backed change to the measured bottleneck.
Run correctness and compare repeated performance distributions and protected metrics.

gates: correctness and safety checks pass unchanged
baseline and candidate share workload and environment fingerprint
tail latency memory throughput and cost remain within protected budgets

state.update_rule: Record workload, environment, samples, profile, hypothesis, diff, protected metrics, and decision for every candidate.

conditions: architectural or capacity decision is required

exit.success: The target performance budget is restored reproducibly with correctness and protected metrics intact.
exit.stop_without_success: The regression cannot be reproduced, measurements are too noisy, budget is exhausted, or an architectural decision is required.
